Yakiya, a Japanese barbecue restaurant, located in Hacienda Heights, CA, offers a unique dining experience with high-quality marbled beef and an exquisite set course meal. Customers rave about the standout dishes such as A5 wagyu with ponzu jelly, chawamushi with snow crab, and A5 chuck rib. The menu is thoughtfully curated, with surprises like homemade red miso dip and a refreshing yuzu dessert. Service is top-notch, with attentive staff like Sunny providing a delightful experience. The only suggestion is to extend the dining time slightly for a more relaxed experience. Overall, Yakiya is a must-visit for those looking for a special occasion spot with excellent food and service.
